title: Inki bar bayte caxaaxuwi arac
intro: taswiir lush caxaaxuwi, qilsi alayso caxâ baxaa kee dariifal fayyale coox. toh dacrissa mari sinnih yascubeenim agiru, ekraariseenih sinni gaaboysoh saaqoota maaci maacisak naharal, too fayxih intiitak iroh. Takkay immay inkinnah xiine waa num gersi ekraaro le ken qeltut tan acwa. atu fayramissam duuddaa miyyay soolam ta maabitinah aydaadu Kur'aanak?
clues: Nanu inki adda caxaaxuwi arac luk sugneeh, kaxxam qaxmeqeeh, taturteh tan maritteh inkih aysinu tekke.
ni ekraaroh addat, nanu tutucneh ninnih saakuuk, faxe fayxi le rooci woo ayro culam maduuda axcuk naybeleeleqeh.
Nanu gadda le marak sugneeh, ni sorkocô baxi dariifal yan baacoytitih gar wagsiisak inti maleelah suge.
nek niyatneh nan gaaboysoh maaci gufa wak, nanu ninni caxaaxuwih aracat xayyowne dubuk data finqa fan milaagimtem gorrisne.
finqitte amri fiyeh, tu macabinna takkay immay gommod alayte caxâ baxi kilasters inki adda waxeexih suge.
Ni aydaadi Qur'aanal tunkuttubeh tan gibdi maabitinaay, nanu caxaaxuwi lewanna axcuk namixxigeeh, faxximta marah sadqah cato abte.

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew. (68:33)
